brief:
Israeli forces demolished a Palestinian family's home in the Farsh al-Hawa area north of Hebron in the southern West Bank, the Ma'an news agency reported. The demolition left the family experiencing profound loss and grief, according to the account.

The incident occurred in a region where house demolitions by Israeli military authorities have been a recurring practice affecting Palestinian residents.

title: Israeli military demolishes Palestinian home north of Hebron
